Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced a flawed source-weighting heuristic that (a) overly privileged any “primary” genealogical snippet and (b) conflated “John F. Dillon” with “John Francis Dillon.” This approach risked adopting the Bellevue, Ohio claim from an auto-generated/genealogy snippet over multiple corroborating authoritative sources (Wikipedia, IMDb, Find a Grave) stating New York City, New York, and thus set the path toward the wrong birthplace.
